reviews.name: Anita & Vikram Shetty
reviews.text: Royal Feast catered our 3-day wedding for 600 guests. Every meal was impeccable — from the traditional sadhya to the fusion dinner. The live pasta counter was a huge hit!

reviews.name: Rohit Goyal
reviews.text: We've worked with Royal Feast for two annual conferences. Professional, punctual and the food quality is consistently outstanding. Our employees look forward to the lunch spread every year.

reviews.name: Deepa Menon
reviews.text: My daughter's 1st birthday was made so special by Royal Feast. The kids' menu was thoughtful, the setup was beautiful and they handled everything while I enjoyed the party.

reviews.name: Karthik Rajan
reviews.text: Booked home-delivered party platter for 20 people. The biryani and kebabs were restaurant-quality. Delivered hot and on time. Will order again for Diwali!

reviews.name: Smita Nair
reviews.text: I've recommended Royal Feast to dozens of my clients. Their willingness to customise menus, attention to dietary restrictions and on-site coordination is unmatched in Bangalore.

faq.q: What is the minimum order for catering?
faq.a: Our catering services start from a minimum of 30 plates. For home-delivered party platters, the minimum is 10 plates.
Absolutely. We offer Jain, vegan, gluten-free and diabetic-friendly options. Just mention your requirements during the booking consultation.
Yes, we offer a complimentary tasting session for confirmed bookings of 100+ plates. For smaller events, a tasting fee of ₹1,500 applies (waived on booking).

faq.q: How far in advance should I book?
faq.a: For weddings and large events, we recommend booking 2–3 months in advance. Corporate and small events can be booked with 1 week's notice.

faq.q: Do you handle the complete setup?
faq.a: Yes, we provide end-to-end service: menu planning, kitchen setup, service staff, live counters, buffet stations and cleanup. You just enjoy the event.
